content:
The Johnson Wolves are headed to the postseason.

Johnson beat the United South Panthers 21-0 on Thursday night, Nov. 5, to secure a playoff spot, according to KGNS. The Wolves finish the regular season 5-2 in district play and 7-3 overall.

The win came in the battle of Southside foes, with Johnson's defense holding United South scoreless.

United South will need a lot of help to reach the playoffs, according to KGNS.

Sources: KGNS (Ryan Bailey), Nov. 6, 2026.
